ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black) peripheral borders and high-intensity (white) interior fields, covering approximately 65% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white fields on the medial-lateral regions of each lobe; thick black pigmentation along the entire upper trailing edge and central peduncle region; distinct vertical black linear strokes protruding from the base into the white fields on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees, depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the trailing edge with increasing frequency and pixel-amplitude towards the distal tips; extreme irregular topography on the left tip due to protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex lower boundary curving upward towards sharp, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white and beige pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization localized on the extreme left and right distal tips; minor circular grey spots visible on the inner right white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical black linear mark on the left white field; several thin, faint vertical rake marks on the lower interior of the right white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and jagged distal tips with significant encrustations and potential material loss on the leftmost edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown discoloration patches visible on the lower interior portions of the white pigmentation fields on both lobes.
